newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar slips in higher currency demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar slips in higher currency demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed virtually unchanged at 475.00/475.50 per dollar Friday, compared to 474.50/475.25 per dollar Thursday, as foreign currency demand increased to take advantage of low prices, dealers said.
"The market was fairly stable. There was less offer than yesterday and there was some corporate buyers to take advantage of the attractive prices," one said.
Despite the higher currency demand traders said the Central Bank had not intervened to maintain the exchange rate.
"I did not see the Central Bank today, I don't think it had to intervene because the market stabilized itself," another trader said.
